title: AppRecord
description: Research record for a single Composio app. Any field the fetched pages did not support must be null, with confidence 'low'.

number.description: 1-indexed position in the source app list.

hint_url.description: Optional starting URL from the source list, before research.

one_liner.description: One-sentence summary of what the app does.

auth.description: How an already-registered developer authenticates API calls. Distinct from `access`.

access.description: How a first-time developer obtains credentials: self-serve signup vs. gated behind sales/partner approval.

reconciliation.description: How the tier squares with gate language found on the same pages.

mcp.description: Whether a Model Context Protocol server exists for this app.

buildability.description: Whether an outside developer could realistically build an integration today. 'no' means they could not (no public access at all); 'unknown' means the pages do not say.

evidence.description: Doc URLs backing the claims above. Every URL here must have been fetched successfully by the pipeline.

quote.description: Verbatim line from that page, verified present at extraction time.

support.description: Per-field verified support: the one line each finding rests on.

unsupported_fields.description: Fields discarded because their quoted line was not found in the fetched text.
